archetype: Ranged DEX bowman. Most of its output comes from persistent summons and homing projectiles layered over a channelled main attack rather than from a few large hits, and it carries unusually strong self-sustain for a bowman: a damage-absorbing barrier (Gale Barrier), a 3-second invincibility window on Monsoon, and a long-distance traversal skill (Wind Walk).

gearingNotes:
Four things change gearing advice for Wind Archer specifically.

1. CRIT RATE DOES NOT STOP MATTERING AT 100%. Wind Archer has the archer skill Vicious Shot, which for 30 seconds lets critical rate exceed 100% and converts critical rate into critical damage (at max level, critical damage increases by 50% of critical rate). Grandis Library's base-stat table lists that conversion as one of the class's crit damage sources. So crit rate above the normal 100% cap still converts to damage inside the burst window, and crit rate should not be treated as a stat to hard-cap. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills (Vicious Shot description), grandislibrary.com Wind Archer base stats.

2. ATTACK SPEED IS ALREADY CAPPED FROM PASSIVES. Agile Bows gives +2 attack speed, Eagle Eye +1 and Albatross Max +1 on top of the bow's base stage. NamuWiki states outright that Wind Archer can reach maximum attack speed (level 8) from its own skills. Consequence: no attack speed inner ability line, and no need to slot Decent Speed Infusion for the attack speed. NamuWiki adds that Song of Heaven, the bossing main attack, is not affected by attack speed at all. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills, en.namu.wiki Wind Archer.

3. COOLDOWN REDUCTION IS WORTH MORE THAN USUAL. NamuWiki flags Wind Archer as cooldown-dependent because Howling Gale, a short-cooldown skill, carries a large share of both sustained and burst damage, and says burst and sustain both drop if cooldown reduction is insufficient. The class doc agrees in the other direction: it says a -4 second cooldown hat is optimal for damage, while a -2 second hat does not beat a stat hat of 30% or more. Sources: en.namu.wiki Wind Archer, Wind Archer FAQ doc.

4. NO ARROW COST, AND A JEWEL SECONDARY. Sylvan Aid lets Wind Archer use skills without consuming arrows, so arrow supply is not a constraint; the class doc still suggests Titanium Arrows for the flat attack. The secondary weapon is a Jewel, which NamuWiki notes cannot be scroll-enhanced but can take potential; the emblem is the Cygnus gold emblem and is untradeable. Sources: maplestorywiki.net/w/Wind_Archer/Skills, Wind Archer FAQ doc, en.namu.wiki Wind Archer.

Nothing unusual about the stat model otherwise: DEX main, STR secondary, normal archer weighting, no HP-as-damage or crit-capping quirk. Wind Archer has no native buff duration from skills (NamuWiki), though HEXA Storm Bringer adds buff duration when built (MapleStory Wiki).

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating 100% critical rate as the point to stop stacking crit.
commonMistakes.why: Vicious Shot allows critical rate above 100% and converts critical rate into critical damage during its 30-second window.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rolling an attack speed line on inner ability.
commonMistakes.why: NamuWiki states the class reaches maximum attack speed (level 8) from its own passives, and the class doc says attack speed investment is not required. See innerAbility.doNotRoll — this is a derived conclusion, not a directly sourced recommendation.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the linked Wind Archer class doc for 6th job planning.
commonMistakes.why: The doc's own header says it was last updated 2023-11-23 and its Sixth Job section is images plus a video link, with no textual ordering. It is still the doc linked from both MapleStory Wiki's class-guide index and Grandis Library, which makes it the first thing a player finds. Grandis' 6th job INFOGRAPHIC is a separate and much newer artifact (dated 2026-09-04) — use that, not the doc.

commonMistakes.mistake: Following Grandis Library's 'HEXA Tracker' link from the Wind Archer page.
commonMistakes.why: That Google Sheet returns HTTP 410 Gone. It has been deleted. The link is still on the page.

commonMistakes.mistake: Building a boost node 'trio' at all, or copying a pre-v.269 trio.
commonMistakes.why: Grandis Library now presents Wind Archer's boost nodes as six fixed nodes under the heading 'Skills Boosted by Each Nodes', and hides its old trio recommendation behind a chip labelled 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes'. The only other consolidated trio table (mastermysty) is dated 2024-11-21 with data from 2024-05-14, so it predates that change too. Both trio lists are historical.

commonMistakes.mistake: Building a Pinpoint Pierce boost node.
commonMistakes.why: The class doc says directly that a Pinpoint Pierce node is not needed because the skill is used once per 60 seconds and the extra damage on the single hit is minimal, and Grandis buckets node 5 (Pinpoint Pierce / Sentient Arrow) as least priority. The widely-copied mastermysty mobbing trio contradicts this, but it is pre-v.269.

commonMistakes.mistake: Trusting search results that use names like 'Song of Heaven VI' or 'Howling Gale VI'.
commonMistakes.why: Those names do not exist. The real names are HEXA Song of Heaven (a Mastery node) and Howling Gale Boost (a HEXA Enhancement node). A page using them has not checked the game.

blockedReason: All 2 recorded defects are resolved and 5 further defects found during resolution are resolved, but the endgame sections still contain content that is not fully verified, so this stays false. Specifically: (1) hexa carries only the first 3 of roughly 180 steps — the remaining order exists as an unreadable icon-only infographic and is not recorded, so hexa is a known gap rather than a verified section; (2) the class doc holds a Reboot-specific inner ability answer behind a Discord link that could not be read, so innerAbility is incomplete for the GMS Heroic target; (3) hyperStats is deliberately null because every source refuses to rank, which is correct but means the section carries no guidance. Every claim that IS present is now labelled with sources, sourceCount, consensus and verifiedAt, and nothing points at a source that does not support it.
